about_the_game:
Curse of Pirates Demo is a fierce voyage across the raging seas, where beneath the shimmering waves lurk deadly sea beasts and ancient chthonic horrors from the deep.

Hoist the sails, grab the helm, and set course for adventure!

Here’s what awaits ye in the demo:

⚓ The “Sea of Time” Biome: two massive maps where danger lurks behind every wave.

⚓ Two mighty bosses: the Vice Admiral and the Kraken — a primordial terror from the darkest ocean depths.

⚓ The Dream Crew: two loyal sea wolves and a fierce she-wolf! ready to follow yer command, offering blessings and unique powers.

⚓ Pirate’s Arsenal: 28 skills to mix and match, craftin’ yer own swashbucklin’ combat style.

⚓ Not just brawlin’: 5 types of quests — from treasure hunts to bounty chases. Boredom be walkin’ the plank here!

⚓ Cursed Captains: two legendary, fearsome foes whose meetings spell nothin’ but trouble.

⚓ Yer First Ship: a trusty starter vessel that’ll serve as yer home on this voyage.

⚓ Enemies Everywhere: 8 types of scurvy dogs await in the first biome, eager to send ye down to Davy Jones’ locker.

Play the demo, share yer thoughts, tell us yer tales, and don’t forget to add the full game to yer wishlist, matey!

short_description: Conquer the dark depths of the ocean, brimming with terrifying beasts and untold treasures! Assemble a mighty crew of scallywags to fend off endless hordes of enemies. Become the captain of yer own fate, ye salty dog!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
